brief.creative_description: Refined abstract background with deep teal and copper flowing forms, subtle texture, soft lighting, and generous calm content-safe areas.
brief.title: Community Excellence Awards

programme.title: Welcome by the master of ceremonies

direction.positive_prompt: A refined abstract background with deep teal and copper flowing forms, featuring subtle texture and soft lighting, The composition includes generous calm content-safe areas with a contemporary feel, suitable for a community recognition event, The background has a soft, almost ethereal quality with hints of copper details adding warmth and elegance
direction.negative_prompt: Avoid any readable text, logos, watermarks, or portraits. The design must not include any specific event details or branding elements.
direction.short_design_rationale: The design focuses on creating an elegant and refined visual experience that aligns with the event's theme of contemporary community recognition. The deep teal and copper color palette, along with the abstract flowing forms, convey a sense of sophistication and unity.

direction.positive_prompt: abstract fluid art, deep teal and copper swirling forms, subtle metallic sheen, soft diffused lighting, organic shapes, flowing movement, refined texture, calming atmosphere, elegant and contemporary, high detail, smooth gradients, digital painting, cinematic quality
direction.negative_prompt: sharp edges, harsh lines, overly bright, cluttered, busy, photographic, realistic, noise, grain, text, logos, portraits
direction.short_design_rationale: This direction evokes a sense of refined calm and sophistication, aligning with the event's 'Contemporary community recognition' theme. The flowing teal and copper forms represent connection and growth. The abstract nature allows for a flexible layout and avoids feeling overly prescriptive.

direction.positive_prompt: A refined abstract background featuring deep teal and copper flowing forms with subtle texture, Soft, diffused lighting creates a calm and inviting atmosphere
direction.negative_prompt: Text, typography, logos, portraits, hard lines, geometric shapes, bright colors, high contrast, and any discernible text or characters.
direction.short_design_rationale: The design aims to create a serene and elegant atmosphere that reflects the theme of community recognition. The use of deep teal and copper colors, along with flowing abstract forms, evokes a sense of unity and achievement. The subtle texture and soft lighting enhance the overall calmness, making it an ideal backdrop for the event programme.
